text:
sophia: Heads up — CI failed for the new quantized bring-up (qmix-v2-4bit) on eval-runner. Metric skew only shows up for the templated prompt cohort, not raw prompts.
ajay: saw that too. AUC drops ~4% for the "instruction + fewshot" templates. other cohorts fine.
kevin: any logs? is this a model quality regression or metric calc bug?
kevin: can you paste the failing assert (or excerpt)?
sophia: log snip:
```
FAIL test_eval_cohort_instructions.py::test_cohort_auc
E AssertionError: expected AUC>0.88 but got 0.837
Runner: eval-runner v0.9.2
Model: qmix-v2-4bit (quant)
Templates: instr_fewshot_v3 (templating engine: format)
```
lina: quick guess — tokenization normalization. some templates add nonbreaking spaces and our token-count truncation step ran on bytes before the tokenizer, so the prompt seen by the model differs between ci and local runs.
nick: also noticed the synthetic prompt generator uses random.choice without fixing the RNG seed per-shard. combined with augmentation salt that includes a timestamp, tests can be nondet across shards.
ajay: oof. two separate problems: (1) nondet fixture seeding, (2) tokenization/truncation ordering. both can flip ranks.
kevin: dashboard note — the cohort dashboard shows percentiles computed on raw logits for the reporting table. front-end converts to probs, but backend wrong value makes the A/B look worse. that's misleading for triage.
sophia: plan: I'll patch augmenter to take an explicit `seed` arg and set numpy/random at runner bootstrap. also normalize templates with `unicodedata.normalize('NFKC')` before tokenization and move truncation to after tokenization.
lina: unit test suggestion: roundtrip tokenization + truncation invariant on all templates in promptbank (add a golden token count file). add to ci-quick so it runs fast.
nick: sample fix snippet I tried locally:
```
# runner bootstrap
import random, numpy as np
random.seed(config.seed)
np.random.seed(config.seed + shard_id)
# augment.py
def choose(args, seed=None):
    rnd = random.Random(seed or GLOBAL_SEED)
    return rnd.choice(options)
```
ajay: also add an eval-ci assertion that cohort hashes (template id + tokenizer checksum + seed) are stable between local <-> CI runs.
eval-bot: [CI] test/eval/cohorts failed on 2009001234 — rerun queued by @sophia :arrow_forward: 
sophia: opening PR with three commits: deterministic-seed, nfkc-normalize, dashboard-fix. will tag @kevin for backend change and @lina for test review. any objections?
kevin: no objections. add a short migration note for infra about previously logged percentiles to avoid confusing historical dashboards.
lina: will add the unit test and a small fixture with a couple of edge-case templates (nonbreaking space, zero-width joiner). :white_check_mark:
ajay: thanks — this explains the weird split-only regression. if CI still flakes after seed fix we'll dig into quant kernel nondeterminism in the runner.
sophia: thanks all — merging soon. will follow up in a separate thread if quant nondet appears.
